findings.label: control-flow
findings.failure_mode: A domain pack's ## Wiring files fenced block contains a line beginning with "## " while the fence is still open; the unconditional /^## /{f=0} reset rule fires regardless of fence state, silently truncating wiring.txt and dropping every legitimate wiring-file entry after that line.
evidence: .claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:392 — /^## /{f=0} matches any line, no b (fence-open) guard
.claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:392 — f&&b print guard stops emitting once f flips to 0 mid-fence
.claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:388-393 — wiring.txt generation is gated only on PACK_PRESENT, never on STALE/PACK_INVALID, so the truncated file still ships
tests/packs/bad-wiring-unfenced.md:9-24 — existing fixture only covers the unclosed-fence case, not this mid-fence heading-lookalike case
